problem_statement: Our booking service holds a slot for a fixed TTL: reserve(slot, now) takes the slot if free and returns an expiry time; confirm(slot, now) finalizes it only while the hold is still live. Today a hold never expires: confirm succeeds however late it arrives, and a slot stays reserved forever, so a second reserve always fails. A hold must expire exactly at reserve_time + ttl — confirm at that instant still succeeds (the deadline is inclusive), confirm after it must raise HoldExpired, and an expired hold frees the slot for a new reserve. A confirmed booking is permanent: it never expires and a reserve on a confirmed slot raises SlotTaken.
